tasks.title: Serve provider read APIs from cached state
tasks.description: Implement a ProviderStateService that builds in-memory snapshots for provider list data and provider model groups, then prewarm it during server startup. Change GET /api/providers and GET /api/providers/models to read those snapshots, with /api/providers omitting model IDs from each provider item.
acceptanceCriteria: Server startup prewarms provider state before accepting HTTP requests
GET /api/providers returns provider metadata without a models field on provider items
GET /api/providers/models returns the same model group shape as before from ProviderStateService
Provider list and model endpoints no longer rebuild all provider/model data inside route handlers on every request
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Build complete immutable snapshots in the service. Keep getProviderConfig(), getBuiltinProviders(), and getModelsByProvider() as the source of truth during snapshot rebuild.

tasks.title: Refresh provider cache after config mutations
tasks.description: Ensure successful provider create/update/delete operations refresh ProviderStateService before returning success. Preserve existing config:providers:changed event emission for other consumers and avoid replacing the current snapshot if a refresh rebuild fails partway through.
acceptanceCriteria: After POST /api/providers/:id creates or updates a provider, subsequent GET /api/providers reflects the new configured state from cache
After POST /api/providers/:id updates custom models, subsequent GET /api/providers/models reflects the updated models from cache
After DELETE /api/providers/:id, subsequent provider and model reads reflect the deletion from cache
config:providers:changed continues to be emitted after successful provider config mutations
A failed refresh does not partially replace the last good provider state snapshot
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer full rebuild on mutation rather than incremental patching, because default provider, custom providers, and model groups share resolution logic.

tasks.title: Update web client for lightweight provider response
tasks.description: Update web provider API types and provider-list consumers so they no longer expect model IDs from GET /api/providers. Keep model selectors and AI settings model data wired to GET /api/providers/models.
acceptanceCriteria: The web Provider type for GET /api/providers no longer includes models
AI settings provider list renders without reading provider.models from GET /api/providers
Model selection still reads selectable models from GET /api/providers/models
No TypeScript errors remain from the removed provider.models field
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not change the model group type returned by /api/providers/models. Only remove the unused provider-list models contract.

tasks.title: Add provider API cache regression tests
tasks.description: Add regression coverage proving the provider API response split and cache refresh behavior. Tests should verify the lightweight provider response, cached model response behavior, and cache updates after provider configuration mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: A test verifies GET /api/providers provider items do not include models
A test verifies GET /api/providers/models returns model groups from provider state without changing the response shape
A test verifies provider config save/delete refreshes cached provider reads
Relevant tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use existing API/service test patterns. If exact file naming differs, place tests with the nearest provider API route tests.
